_: Tests that are deliberately not in the release workflow's test chain (they may be in a check workflow). name, reason (required); run:false = the preflight does not run it (a helper, or it needs something this machine lacks); args/env = how the preflight runs it properly (env value $TMPZIP = a small zip made by the preflight).

tests.name: filesphone-fixture.cjs
tests.reason: A helper (the pretend phone for filesclip.cjs and filesback.cjs), not a test.

tests.name: hunt.cjs
tests.reason: The bug hunt: 40 rounds over every page; slow (minutes), meant to be run by hand before a release, not on every push.

tests.name: market.cjs
tests.reason: Needs MARKET_DIR, a folder with local copies of two third-party GitHub repositories (Bas1874/Seanime-Marketplace, tanzim2000/hayase-extension) that are not in this repository; run by hand with MARKET_DIR set.

tests.name: prism.cjs
tests.reason: Needs ZIP_FILE, any zip; the preflight makes a small one.

tests.name: screenfake.cjs
tests.reason: A helper (the pretend screen for tauribridge.cjs and screentauri.cjs), not a test.

tests.name: stream.cjs
tests.reason: Needs outside network hosts (see known-failures.json); not in any workflow.

tests.name: tauribrowsertools.cjs
tests.reason: Runs in tauri-check.yml (Linux, Playwright 1.48.2, Chromium installed). It passes here (Playwright 1.56.0, 2.5 s) but timed out after 32 s in the preflight job, which installs Playwright 1.64.1; the cause there is not known, so the preflight does not run it.

tests.name: webstream.cjs
tests.reason: Needs the webtorrent package from desktop/package.json (cd desktop && npm install), which the preflight and release-tools.yml jobs do not install; it runs in webstream-check.yml, which installs it on three systems.
